title: Integration against a density
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $ho$ be a nonnegative function on the binary cube $ br_2^n$ with uniform mean $1$, and let $g: br_2^n\to\bbr$ be any function. The integral of $g$ with respect to the probability measure whose density relative to uniform measure is $ho$ equals the uniform mean of $\rho g$.
